answer: Every autonomous AI agent must maintain 1 exclusive service-slot reservation to function as a verified node, treating any occupancy overlap on its designated island of compute as an immediate breach that triggers revocation. A central validator audits these reservations against the tide of traffic, where an honest participant pays the nominal fee while 1,000 fakes must incur the impossible cost of parallel infrastructure to remain active across the digital tundra. Any detected collision in slot usage locks the bond for 90 days as evidence of failure.
